test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following fundamental duties is added by the 86th Amendment of the constitution in 2002?

options.text: To defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so
To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
To cherish and follow the noble ideals which inspired our national struggle for freedom
Who is a parent or guardian, to provide opportunities for education to his child, or as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 86th Amendment of the Constitution of India in 2002 added the fundamental duty of parents and guardians to provide educational opportunities for their children between the ages of six and fourteen years.
 
• The 86th Amendment also added Article 21A to the Constitution, which made education a fundamental right for children in this age group.
 
• The amendment mandates that the state provide free and compulsory education to all children in this age group. 
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 originally added 10 fundamental duties to the Constitution.
 
• These duties emphasize the moral obligations of citizens to uphold India's unity and promote patriotism.
